sentence: law tro7 el sooq jeeb li 3esh
raw: law tro7 el sooq jeeb li 3esh
ipa: ˈlaw tiˈruːħ asˈsuːɡ ˈdʒiːb ˈliː ˈʕeːʃ
gloss_en: if you go to the market, bring me rice
notes: [daily] Arabizi: 7=ح, 3=ع. Spells لو تروح السوق جيب لي عيش. unsupported; ipa = Emirati reading: لو conditional keeps [law] (resists Gulf ay/aw→ē/ō monophthongization) and عيش→[ʕeːʃ] 'rice/food' (szreder_derrick2023) — both Emirati facts the monophthongizing pipeline misses.
